# A 100.00 USD bill overpaid with 200.00 USD out of a USD bank.
#
# The vendor now holds 100.00 USD of the book's money, which is a claim on
# them: currency the book still owns, at what it cost to send. GnuCash leaves
# two splits on the payable — the one that settles the bill, and the
# overpayment, a debit balance on A/P.
#
# Every split of the payment is USD, so no base-currency figure prices it and
# the claim's cost is written down as `cost_basis_cost` instead. What this
# fixture produces in `fx-balances`:
#
#   Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD   1.4 CAD/USD   100.00 USD   (overpaid)
#
# Used by the bill side of the applied-credit tests: a later bill spends part
# of that claim, and the basis has to follow what is left of it.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD
	type: Accounts Payable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

vendor "V-US"
	name: "US Supplier"
	currency: USD

bill "BILL-USD-OVER"
	vendor_id: "V-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Parts"
		action: "Material"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
		memo: "Bill BILL-USD-OVER"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 200
		account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
		prepayment: 100
		memo: "Payment for BILL-USD-OVER"
